Vibrant and commanding, the crest demands respect from the beasts that crawl about.
Challengers Crest Wearing the Wealdhelm grants Advantage on Charisma 
(Intimidation) checks made against Beasts as the colorful crest asserts dominance. 
This has no effect on Beasts that do not see or are in complete darkness.  
Nnull Hide Wearing the Weadlhelm adds +1 to AC. In addition, it grants +3 AC 
against Acid damage.
Scaled Covering While wearing the helmet, the wielder suffers Disadvantage on 
Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

A mark of a warrior more than anything else, the gorget is a sign of brutality and strength.
Ruske Rampage As an Action, if you move at least 20 ft. toward a target creature 
immediately before attempting to attack, you can make a Tusked Charge Action. 
Tusked Charge Melee Attack Roll: Your Strength modifier used to make the attack 
roll plus your Proficiency Bonus, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + your Strength 
modifier Piercing damage. If the target creature is Medium sized or smaller, and 
the attack hits, the target has the Prone condition.

Fronghillie Cloak
2 Frondilli Leaf Furred Hides
Supplies: 2
The deer's natural camouflage allows the wearer to blend into the woods, unseen and safe.
The Fronghillie Cloak can be worn over Light and Medium armor.  
Weald Leaf While in the Wealdwoods or similarly forested environment, you have 
Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to Hide. In addition, while remaining 
motionless and taking no actions, Attackers have Disadvantage on Ranged attack 
rolls against you if you are more than 30 ft. from them.
Kin Garbed While wearing the Fronghillie Cloak you have Advantage on Animal 
(Wisdom) checks with frondilli deer.
